title: PEPA offices close for Thanksgiving. Here’s how to report an outage.
excerpt: Pontotoc Electric offices will close Nov. 26 and 27. The holiday dispatcher can take outage calls for Pontotoc at 662-489-6711 and Bruce at 662-983-2727.
locality: Pontotoc Electric Power Association offices serving Pontotoc and Bruce, Mississippi.

facts.statement: Pontotoc Electric Power Association will close its offices Thursday and Friday, Nov. 26 and 27, for Thanksgiving. Members who lose electricity during the closure can still reach a dispatcher. The holiday number for Pontotoc is 662-489-6711. In Bruce, call 662-983-2727.
facts.evidence: Read the date pair on the holiday graphic and both numbers in PEPA’s accompanying notice. Cross-checked the numbers on PEPA’s outage page.
facts.locality: Pontotoc Electric Power Association offices serving Pontotoc and Bruce, Mississippi.
facts.identities: Pontotoc Electric Power Association and its member households.

facts.statement: The Pontotoc number in the holiday notice is PEPA’s after-hours line. The regular Pontotoc office number is 662-489-3211. Bruce uses the same number for dispatch that PEPA lists for the local office. The association says operators take trouble calls around the clock.
facts.evidence: Compare the ordinary office and after-hours contact entries against the holiday notice.
facts.statistics: Regular Pontotoc office 662-489-3211. Dispatch available 24 hours a day.
facts.locality: Pontotoc Electric Power Association offices serving Pontotoc and Bruce, Mississippi.
facts.identities: Pontotoc Electric Power Association and its member households.

facts.statement: PEPA asks members to report an outage at their own address, even if neighbors have also lost service. Once a member reports it, another call about the same location can tie up a line or create a second ticket. Call again if there is an emergency. The association also links to its public outage map from its outage information page.
facts.evidence: The public FAQ addresses neighboring outages, repeat calls and the customer map.
facts.statistics: No number of current outages asserted.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc Electric Power Association will close its offices Thursday and Friday, Nov. 26 and 27, for Thanksgiving. Members who lose electricity during the closure can still reach a dispatcher. The holiday number for Pontotoc is 662-489-6711. In Bruce, call 662-983-2727.

The Pontotoc number in the holiday notice is PEPA’s after-hours line. The regular Pontotoc office number is 662-489-3211. Bruce uses the same number for dispatch that PEPA lists for the local office. The association says operators take trouble calls around the clock.

PEPA asks members to report an outage at their own address, even if neighbors have also lost service. Once a member reports it, another call about the same location can tie up a line or create a second ticket. Call again if there is an emergency. The association also links to its public outage map from its outage information page.
